revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template webtoon-shot-v1. Canvas 1536x2048, keep 6% safe margin. A single close-up top-down portrait-lens-feel shot with subtle push-in. Camera is directly above a worn final ledger and the dark sleeve of a middle-aged man; focus on only his hand gripping the last ledger tightly, face and full body never shown. Leave a quiet negative space at upper center/upper left for monologue: left 27%, top 3%, width 46%, height 20%, with no text.

Composition: the ledger dominates the lower-middle/right area at a diagonal, with the hand entering from upper-right toward center, knuckles tense, wrinkles visible, fingers pressing into the cracked leather cover and cord. The perspective forms a long diagonal from the ledger corner toward the back of the hand. In the lower-left edge, only a tiny dissolving ash silhouette of a child’s hand/fingertips is implied, almost disappearing off frame, suggesting young Theo’s memory ending on the ledger. No child face visible.

Background and props: memory fragment on a wooden table with torn map scraps beneath/around the ledger, muted and partially obscured. Add drifting ash/dust in foreground and around the child-hand trace. No flames. No crowns, no weapons, no battle imagery. No readable writing anywhere.

Style and treatment: refined Korean webtoon illustration, restrained 2D painterly texture, clean but not hyperreal linework. Emphasize hand wrinkles and the ledger strap sharply, but avoid excessive realism. Palette of charcoal gray, faded paper beige, dark brown, worn leather blue-gray sleeve accents. Mood: nameless defeat, compressed responsibility for a fallen kingdom. Lighting is dull gray and faded brown, soft and heavy.

Reference use: Image 1 only for character identity cues of Theo as implied child-memory hand/ash trace. Image 2 only for background-space and object mood from the source crop around the hand, map, ledger, and table. Generate no speech balloons, captions, readable text, watermark, or signature.
